changes.after: These are integrated link variables in each level's own unit lattice, and all adjoints use ordinary counting inner products. US1 is the quadratic part of the **u-stripped normalized tree phase** `F_tree=sum_p s(U_p)+sum_(j,c) kappa_j phi_(M_c(U_j))(U_(j+1),c)`, where `phi_M(V)=N^-1[max_W Re tr(W^-1 M)-Re tr(V^-1 M)]` and the maximum is over `SU(N)`. Its stationary value is the `T_n` used in FC18–FC20. The quadratic contour-spread term cancels in this phase. The exact finite-u negative logdensity also contains the field-dependent logarithm of a Haar integral, whose quadratic spread contribution is nonzero at finite u; US1 is not its full Hessian divided by u. FC18's fourth-order polar terms refer to `F_tree` and `T_n`.
